# Michel Adventures

> Personal adventure log for climbing trips and outdoor adventures.

micheladventures.com is the personal adventure log of Michel Laclé. Each climbing trip and outdoor adventure gets its own page with photos, videos, and trip notes. The site is a static HTML site hosted on GitHub Pages.

## Pages

- [Home](https://micheladventures.com/): Trip list and site intro
- [Cherokee Rock Village, Sand Rock AL](https://micheladventures.com/trips/cherokee-rock-village.html): 2026 bouldering trip to Sand Rock, Alabama — first entry

New trip pages are added as trips wrap up.
